cards.name: Snooping Newsie
cards.oracleText:
When this creature enters, mill two cards. (Put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)
As long as there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.

cards.name: Snooping Page
cards.oracleText:
Repartee — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets a creature, this creature can't be blocked this turn.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you draw a card and lose 1 life.
